quick_facts.sprint_goal: Deliver the MVP: a cashier processes a sale end-to-end — cart → payment confirmation → auto-issued Vietnamese electronic tax invoice — all in under 10 seconds.

content.tldr: Sprint 3 is the MVP sprint. Order lifecycle + invoice auto-generation. After this sprint, the system delivers real business value: a cashier can process a legal POS sale.

features_committed.title: Order Lifecycle
features_committed.rationale: Core POS flow. A sale is an order. Invoice depends on order completion.

features_committed.title: Electronic Invoice Generation
features_committed.rationale: Legal requirement. Every completed order must produce a compliant hóa đơn điện tử.

also_this_sprint: Frontend: POS screen — product search + cart management
out_of_scope: Refund UI / flow (Sprint 4 — backend state machine supports refunded state but UI deferred)
prerequisites: Backend running with auth + store + product endpoints live
Frontend login + product pages from Sprint 2 complete

mvp_definition.statement: A cashier can: log in → search products → create an order with items → confirm payment → receive a generated invoice number — all within one browser session.
mvp_definition.acceptance: Demo this flow end-to-end in a review meeting. Invoice number is unique and immutable. Tax subtotals are correct.

what_went_well: Orders + Invoices backend complete with 36 unit tests
BUG-0005 (Docker missing event-emitter) identified and fixed
what_to_improve: No integration tests or E2E tests — safety net gap identified
Frontend pages exist but are un-navigable (no AppLayout/nav) — Sprint 4 must fix this
User management API endpoints (GET /auth/users, PATCH /auth/users/:id/deactivate) not yet built
action_items: Sprint 4: Implement AppLayout + role-aware nav as P0
Sprint 4: Pull forward Playwright E2E setup (was Sprint 12 originally)
Sprint 4: Add missing user management backend endpoints before user-ui frontend work

audit.author: vibe-product-owner
audit.note: Sprint 3 (MVP) planned at high-level roadmap session.

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 3 closed. Velocity 2/2. Backend (orders + invoices + 36 unit tests) and 3 frontend pages complete. QA gap noted: no E2E or integration tests exist. Sprint 4 kickoff initiated.
